contracts.claim: Receipts use known schemas, producer phases, parseable timestamps, required fields and verification decisions; invalid input is rejected before append.
Locked appends persist the exact serialized stream tail, preserve concurrent receipts and bound retention; invalid input creates no stream.
Receipt reads skip malformed rows, filter by mission before limiting and preserve durable stream order.
Mutable dataclass factories produce distinct containers; receipt validation and phase control reject shared default factories.
File-safe mission IDs confine all layout paths to their canonical mission root; create builds the directories and create=false does not write.
Executor handoff contains bounded goal/compact plan/selected skill IDs/file scope; wrong schemas and planner-only raw context are excluded.
Verifier handoff contains compact goal/plan/execution and ordered deduplicated changed files/artifacts; runtime metadata is excluded.
Empty skill selection blocks and irrelevant selected skills need review; counts exactly reflect inspected selection.
Mission envelopes preserve lifecycle vocabulary, known schema, parseable timestamps and independently owned mutable state.
Phase control follows accepted successors/status, preserves receipt references, bounds repair loops, blocks exhausted repair and refuses terminal/completed restarts.
The five simulated local harness journeys produce exact durable summaries and distinct attempt receipts; receipt flags clearly exclude real external/model execution.

Continuity writes under the mission lock increment the current revision once, persist exact facts and preserve the preceding valid snapshot; corrupt state recovers previous facts without inventing progress.
GPU decisions preserve estimated session cost, policy blockers, and duration/idle release requirements.

Active security decisions require authorized owner/target/action scope and action-time approval where required; invalid budgets normalize safely and purple-team phases keep auditor/red/blue/defender separation.
Security phase readiness exactly matches executable candidates; planned/unavailable tools never satisfy missing defensive coverage.
Turn modes preserve the goal and checks: plan adds the written-plan gate, fast lowers effort and caps a selected budget, max-context raises effort and Deep Run budget, standard preserves semantics.
Successful control-room JSON writes equal the durable normalized payload before returning.
CLI orchestration returns only when the saved mission, runtime autonomy and receipt agree on concurrency/observation/merge/awareness policy.
Matched red-team tasks use adversarial verification intent; matched blue-team tasks use defensive detection intent, with distinct mission types.
Dialogue contains only eligible captured output or durable runtime-output text, preserving runtime/model/source/capture provenance and excluding control events.
Transcript attachment requires concrete output or artifact evidence, retains rejected-session evidence, prefers the latest concrete session, and exposes missing evidence without synthetic messages.
Agent-message projection preserves dialogue receipts and marks control-room planning, actions, heartbeats and integrity notes as trace-only bookkeeping.
Mission read models preserve identity, lifecycle and filtered ordered receipts without changing missions.json; foreign snapshots never replace the current mission.
Flight-recorder projection preserves written phase, process IDs and bounded event history; absent or invalid snapshots never invent events.
Hard artifact completion requires both meaningful runtime output and concrete artifact evidence; either missing boundary stays failed.
Artifact repair completes only after the failed gate is actually ready and no unrelated failures remain; rejected repairs preserve mission state and successful repair is durable.
Public-launch digest selects the freshest saved evidence and preserves operator repair/publication fields; missing receipts cannot claim readiness.
Storage launch admission blocks only from saved measured-capacity evidence; unknown or failed probe states never invent disk pressure.
Explicit platform parsing preserves Windows drive and tail when converting to POSIX mount form and preserves native paths; parsing does not probe or launch WSL.
Mission observers retain tasks, normalize unknown states, compute prerequisite levels and progress, and preserve draft/paused/stopped phases
Mission drafts need a goal, folder, task prompts, acceptance and a positive optional budget
Creation trims fields, preserves harness/model routing and removes self/missing prerequisites; optional positive budget is rounded
Planning asks for the real mission.create tool and explicitly leaves starting to the person
